FORT SAM HOUSTON · TEXAS

A clearer plan
for your visit.

Fort Sam Houston Community Pharmacy is listed at 2401 Winfield Scott Rd, Fort Sam Houston, TX 78234, in the Fort Sam Houston Exchange. Find the listed hours, contact number and directions here before setting out.

Military pharmacy visits can involve eligibility, identification and prescription activation requirements. Check the official pharmacy instructions and speak directly with the team about your circumstances. The website’s service guides explain useful questions to prepare.

Keep prescription requests within the official pharmacy channels. A website visit request is a request for contact and arrangements; it does not activate a prescription, establish benefit eligibility or confirm that medication is ready.

Explore pharmacy service guides

HOW WE AIM TO MAKE THINGS EASIER

Clear conversations.
Practical next steps.

A visit should leave you clearer
about what happens next.

01

Room for your questions

It can be difficult to explain a concern when you are unsure of the medical language. Start with what you have noticed or what the instructions say. A short note of your questions can help you remember the points that matter to you.

02

Explanations that make sense

Medicine labels and service information can raise more questions than expected. Our aim is to explain the next step in straightforward language. Ask for something to be repeated or clarified if you are still unsure before you leave.

03

The appropriate next step

Not every concern can be dealt with in a pharmacy. A useful conversation also means understanding when to contact your prescribing clinician or another service. For urgent concerns, contact your healthcare team. Call 911 in an emergency.

A LITTLE PREPARATION HELPS

Before you visit.

Confirm the pickup location, readiness information, required identification and any access arrangements with the pharmacy. Keep medical and identification details out of website forms.
